tagline.en: Keep the complexity inside the code, and leave the simplicity to whoever uses it.
tagline.zh: 把复杂留在代码里，把简单留给用的人。

bio.en: Software engineer and UI designer. Everything I ship is small: a clipboard, a notebook, a font tool. It opens, it works, it gets out of the way. Most of them carry a cat in the name.
bio.zh: 软件工程师，也做 UI 设计。我做的东西都很小：一个剪贴板、一本笔记、一个字体工具 —— 打开就能用，用完就走。它们大多名字里带着一只猫。

about.en: I'm Martin. Java and JavaScript pay the bills; the evenings go into small tools I genuinely use myself — that is how Miaomiao Bar, Miaomiao Notes and Font Squeeze started.
about.zh: 我是 Martin。白天写 Java 和 JavaScript，晚上做一点自己真的会用的小工具 —— 喵喵剪贴板、喵喵笔记、字压都是这么来的。

about.en: I only have one rule: no tutorial required. So they stay local-first, with no account and no cloud black box in between.
about.zh: 判断标准只有一条：装上之后不需要教程。所以它们大多本地优先，不要账号，中间也没有一层云端黑盒。

about.en: Over these years I have been moving them onto Cloudflare Workers — a tiny tool can now stay online all year without a server bill.
about.zh: 这几年我在把它们一个个搬到 Cloudflare Workers 上 —— 一个小工具不花服务器钱，也能一年 365 天在线。

summary.en: One-click desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness — install, launch and upgrade without touching a terminal.
summary.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键桌面启动器：装好、启动、升级，全程不用终端。

summary.en: An AI-narrated xianxia text RPG: play Li Feiyu three years before Han Li joins the sect, pick A/B/C, and a language model writes every scene. No account, no database — open the page and play
summary.zh: 凡人修仙传同人 AI 文字修仙游戏：扮演厉飞雨，故事从韩立拜入七玄门的三年前开始，选项式推进、剧情由大模型实时生成；无需注册登录、无数据库，打开网页就能玩。

summary.en: Maowo Blog — a personal, independent blog for Cloudflare Workers
summary.zh: 猫窝博客：为读者而生的个人独立博客系统。

summary.en: The clipboard workbench for macOS: whatever lands on it — a paragraph, a column of names, a picture — comes back cleaned, tidied and ready to paste.
summary.zh: 喵喵剪贴板：macOS 上的剪贴板工作台，文字和图片进了剪贴板就变成能直接用的样子。

summary.en: Miaomiao Notes — a cute, local-first Markdown notes app for macOS, synced through iCloud Drive.
summary.zh: 喵喵笔记：一只喵喵的本地 Markdown 笔记应用，通过 iCloud Drive 同步。

summary.en: Lock-free rate limiter for Java 8+: token bucket, leaky bucket, sliding window, fixed window, warm-up and a concurrency bulkhead
summary.zh: 无锁限流库：六种算法，单 jar 零依赖。

summary.en: Educational symptom self-check on a medical knowledge graph: pick a body part and your symptoms, and it ranks candidate diseases by how much of your input they explain. Not a diagnosis
summary.zh: 医疗知识图谱驱动的症状自查：选身体部位、勾选症状，按「能解释你多少症状」给候选疾病排序，并筛掉不可能的科室；覆盖 7733 种疾病、4697 个症状。仅供科普参考，不能替代诊断。

summary.en: A browser-only WebFont subsetter and container converter for ttf/woff/woff2 — fonts never leave the page
summary.zh: 字压：纯前端字体按需裁剪与格式转换工具。

summary.en: An AI agent in your sidebar: it reads the page you are on, answers, clicks on your behalf, and turns a one-line goal into a running automation script.
summary.zh: 装在侧边栏里的 AI 智能体：读你正在看的网页、回答问题、替你点按钮，一句话就能生成并运行自动化脚本。

summary.en: One HTTP request lands in QQ or Telegram — or put a link on your site so visitors ask anonymously, and you answer from QQ.
summary.zh: 一条 HTTP 请求，消息直达 QQ 或 Telegram；也能把链接挂到网站上，访客匿名提问、你在 QQ 里引用回复。

summary.en: 115 tools for formatting, converting, encoding, cropping and compressing — all running in your browser, so what you paste never gets uploaded.
summary.zh: 115 个在线工具：格式化、互转、编码、裁剪压缩图片。全部在浏览器里跑，粘进去的内容不上传。
